missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Помощь' is a feminine -ь noun in the nominative, subject of 'нужна', which agrees in feminine gender. 'Твоя' marks whose help, intensified by 'очень'.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Помощь' is the accusative direct object of 'предложил'; the -ь feminine accusative matches the nominative. 'Мне' is the dative recipient and 'свою' agrees.
Strategic focus: Genitive after просить. 'Помощи' is the genitive of the -ь feminine, used because 'просить' takes the genitive for abstract requests. 'У соседа' names the source.
Strategic focus: Dative after благодаря. 'Помощи' is the dative governed by 'благодаря', expressing the cause of success. 'Друзей' is the genitive showing whose help.
Strategic focus: Instrumental in idiom. 'Помощью' is the feminine instrumental in 'с помощью', here meaning to come to help. 'Быстро' adds the manner of their arrival.
Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'О помощи' uses the prepositional form after 'о' to mean discussing aid. 'Беженцам' is the dative naming who receives it.
Strategic focus: Nominative subject with verb. 'Помощь' is the nominative subject of 'пришла', which agrees in feminine gender. 'Слишком поздно' qualifies the timing.
Strategic focus: Genitive after без. 'Помощи' is the genitive required by 'без', expressing absence. 'Врача' is the genitive naming whose help, in an impersonal clause.
Strategic focus: Prepositional after нуждаться в. 'Помощи' is the prepositional after 'в', governed by 'нуждаются', which always takes this construction. 'Нашей' agrees in the feminine prepositional.
Strategic focus: Nominative subject in compound. 'Помощь' is the nominative head of the set phrase 'скорая помощь', subject of 'приехала'. 'Скорая' agrees, and the time phrase ends the line.
